title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Decent performance with clear, deep but slightly distant sound; recording praised as one of the better versions despite a missing track.
ai_review.review: The show is considered average – not especially tight but not bad – and there are no specific standout moments mentioned. The recording is noted for its clarity and depth, though it sounds a bit distant, and it’s regarded as one of the better available sources despite an odd file‑mixup that leaves a track missing.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is modest (average performance) while recording quality is generally good with some depth, leading to a weighted average around 3.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and deep sound but slightly distant; praised as one of the better versions available. One reviewer notes a missing track in the MP3 zip, indicating an incomplete file set.
